title: Turn our Figma screens into a working web interface

title: Cut our conference footage into something people will watch

title: Grow our following and run the money behind it

title: Keep our books straight and close each month
description: Match our bank lines against what the three shops recorded, keep the ledger tidy, and give us a short monthly summary of where the money actually went. We are two months behind.

title: Take the admin off my plate

title: Get six thousand paper cards onto the system
description: We have boxes of handwritten patient cards that need to exist in the computer instead. Careful, repetitive work where accuracy matters far more than speed, and confidentiality is not negotiable.
